title: Say Freeze! Frozen Trail photo competition open now
body:
# Say Freeze! Frozen Trail photo competition open now

Hey Raiders,

The camera gadget has arrived, and it brings with it a new community photo competition: SAY FREEZE!

We want Raiders to venture Topside and capture the best shots of the new Frozen Trail update. Photograph the dread of the Frigate, the depths of the Emperor, or the blizzards sweeping through Pendola Pass! Selfies are welcome, and we're actively encouraging them.

# How to submit photos

**Join our Discord to share your photos** with us! Embark developers will pick their 10 favourite entries, and each winner will receive **1,150 Raider Tokens**, which can be spent in the store on cosmetics (or even the new Premium Reward Pass). Winners will also get an **exclusive Backpack Charm**, the Instant Film Camera!

Submissions run from **October 16-26**. We're excited to see the Frozen Trail update through your eyes!

The full Terms and Conditions are available for you to read.

Get snapping, see you Topside!

The ARC Raiders Team
